summary: TIM S.A. filed a Form 6-K to announce that Fitch Ratings affirmed its National Long-Term Rating at AAA (bra) with a Stable Outlook. This is a routine credit rating affirmation, not a special situation event. The filing contains no terms, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisors, or mechanical structures. It is an ordinary current report of a foreign private issuer that does not meet the criteria for any special-situations category. The credit rating action is a periodic update with no actionable corporate event.
